mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 and can prolong QT interval; azithromycin is a known CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase valbenazine exposure, and both agents carry risk of torsades de pointes.
action: Monitor QTc interval; consider baseline and periodic ECG monitoring; use with caution and at lowest effective doses; assess for signs of valbenazine toxicity.
